chunks: He said: Abul Hasan Ali ibn Bilal al-Mahlabi reported to me from Abul Abbas Ahmad ibn al-Husayn al-Baghdadi, who reported from al-Husayn ibn Umar al-Muqri, from Ali ibn al-Azhar, from Ali ibn Salih al-Makki, from Muhammad ibn Umar ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather (peace be upon him),

He said: When the following was revealed to the Prophet: 'When the victory granted by Allah and the conquest comes,' he said to me: 'O Ali, surely the victory from Allah and the conquest has come! So when you see people entering into the religion of Allah in throngs, then celebrate the praise of your Lord and seek His forgiveness, for He is ever Relenting.'

'O Ali, Allah has ordained for the believers to fight the dissent after I have gone, just as He ordained for them to fight the polytheists with me.' So I said: 'O Messenger of Allah, what is the dissent?' He said: 'The dissent of a people who testify Allah's Oneness and my Prophethood, yet contradict my traditions and slander my religion.'

So I said: 'On what basis should we fight them?' He said: 'On the basis of their innovations, their departure from my command, and their deeming lawful the blood of my kinfolk.' Then Ali asked about martyrdom, and the Prophet foretold his martyrdom, pointing to his head and beard. Ali said it would be an occasion for glad tidings, not patience. The Prophet told him to prepare for the dispute.

I said: 'Guide me to success.' He said: 'When you find people turning from guidance to misguidance, oppose them. Guidance is from Allah and misguidance from Satan. True guidance is following Allah's command without desires. It is as if I see you facing people who misinterpret the Quran, make intoxicants lawful as grape juice, cheating as zakat, and bribery as gifts.'

I said: 'Are they apostates or dissenters?' He said: 'They are dissenters, wandering until justice overtakes them.' I said: 'Justice from us or others?' He said: 'From us. By us Allah commences and concludes. By us He united hearts after polytheism, and by us He will unite hearts after dissent.' I said: 'Praise be to Allah for His bounty.'

key_terms.الجهاد: Jihad - struggle, armed resistance against dissent
key_terms.الشهادة: Shahada - martyrdom, promised to Imam Ali by the Prophet
key_terms.الفتنة: Fitna - trial, dissent, civil strife among Muslims
key_terms.عترتي: Itrati - my kinfolk/progeny, the Ahl al-Bayt

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad tell Imam Ali about fighting dissent after his death?
ai.summary: In this prophetic tradition from al-Amali of al-Mufid, the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) informs Imam Ali (AS) upon the revelation of Surah al-Nasr that after his departure, the believers would be required to fight dissent (fitna) caused by those who outwardly profess Islam but contradict the Prophetic Sunnah. The Prophet foretells Ali's martyrdom and promises that ultimate justice will come through the Ahl al-Bayt.
